subject: Greypoint renewal: capacity surge, VPC isolation and term options
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana@greypoint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: Greypoint renewal: capacity surge, VPC isolation and term options

Hi Sana —

Quick note to start the renewal conversation and capture the asks you mentioned on the call last week. TL;DR: we can support the surge + isolation you need, and there are a couple of term/discount options to consider that will materially reduce unit cost.

What we heard from your team
- Add two dedicated private clusters (additional GPU capacity) to support peak processing windows for claims ingestion.
- Keep the existing VPC but provision an EU-isolated enclave for EU customer data (geo-fenced).
- Want a 30% on-demand burst reserve for seasonal spikes (30 days / quarter).
- Procurement timeline target: end of Oct if pricing and T&Cs look good.

Proposal summary (high level)
- Capacity: +2 dedicated clusters (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) in your primary region, 30% burst pool reserved cross-cluster.
- Term options: 12-month (baseline) vs 24-month (preferred) with prepay discount. 24-month gives 10% off list GPU unit price + priority capacity.
- One EU enclave as a managed VPC extension with isolated storage and audit logs.

I've attached a demand forecast workbook and an initial pricing SOW so you can see the numbers. If you can confirm whether the EU enclave needs HSM integration for key management (or if your KMS is acceptable), we'll lock the SOW.

Next steps
1) Please confirm procurement timeline and whether you need an air-gapped option (we think a VPC-enclave will suffice).
2) Tell us if the 24-month/10% prepay option is of interest and whether you prefer to prepay all or a portion.
3) Share the billing contact and PO timing so Ben/Neha can reserve capacity pricing.

Attachment: Greypoint_DemandForecast.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
loganw@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Sana Iqbal <sana@greypoint.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Greypoint Health Procurement <procurement@greypoint.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 14:43:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Greypoint renewal: capacity surge, VPC isolation and term options

Logan — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: we are committed to increasing throughput for Q1 processing next year and need firm numbers to finalize the budget.

Key items from procurement:
- We do require an EU-edge enclave (data residency) in addition to the US private clusters. The EU enclave needs the ability to route EU-only traffic and have separate audit/log retention for 7 years.
- HSM: we prefer to use our own cloud KMS (Azure Key Vault) if possible; please indicate whether Redwood can integrate with customer-managed KMS for the EU enclave.
- Pricing: Procurement is asking for a firm quote and SOW line items they can send to finance.
- Timeline: target internal PO sign-off by 2027-10-28, procurement has a two-week review window.

Attached is our budget approval memo so you can match numbers to internal line items. If we can get a final SOW and DocuSign by 10/15 we should be able to meet the 10/28 PO target.

On the term: we are open to a 24-month commit if the unit economics are compelling and if there's an option to include a mid-term capacity re-eval (e.g., ability to add an extra cluster in month 13 at locked-in rates).

Thanks — can we do a short technical call this week to confirm the KMS and logging requirements?

Attachment: GP_budget_approval.pdf (pdf)

—
Sana Iqbal
Head of Infrastructure | Greypoint Health
sana@greypoint.ai | +44 20 7123 4555

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Greypoint renewal: capacity surge, VPC isolation and term options

Sana — appreciate the clarity. I pulled together a short SOW extract and pricing options so procurement has something concrete. See the highlights below and the attached SOW (Greypoint_SOW_v1.pdf).

SOW highlights (extract)
- Base: existing private environment (no change).
- Add: 2 x dedicated clusters (H100-equivalent), estimated token throughput + throughput headroom for your Q1 spikes.
- Burst pool: 30% reserved across clusters, billed at burst rate; reserve buy-down option if you want to convert to committed units.
- EU enclave: fully-managed VPC extension, separate audit bucket, 7-year log retention, optional customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault) integration (requires an additional security review and a short HSM connector configuration fee).

Pricing options (illustrative)
- 12-month: list price for new clusters + standard onboarding fee.
- 24-month: 10% off new cluster unit price with either (A) full prepay, or (B) 6-month prepay for 5% discount + 5% invoice credit at month 12.
- Capacity add-on clause: locked-in unit rates for additions made in months 13-18 if PO / intent documented in renewal paperwork.

Procurement asks we need from you
1) Confirm whether you want the 24-month option and which prepay model.
2) Confirm Azure Key Vault integration is acceptable; if yes, Neha will kick off the security checklist.
3) Provide the finance contact and PO cadence so we can schedule pricing lock.

If procurement needs a slightly different payment cadence, we can run the number through Sales Ops — happy to propose an amortization schedule that keeps pricing close to the 10% headline.

Attachment: Greypoint_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

—
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0189

Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 08:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Greypoint renewal: capacity surge, VPC isolation and term options

Hi Sana — following up as we approach your procurement window. A couple of operational items to close so we can hand this off to Enablement and Infra for scheduling: 

Operational checklist (items we need to finalize)
- KMS: Can Greypoint confirm whether Azure Key Vault (customer-managed) will be used for both US and EU enclaves, or only the EU enclave? If customer-managed, we need the service principal and ACLs to validate.
- Audit logs & retention: we can support 7-year retention in the EU enclave; confirm S3 bucket naming and whether logs should be stored in a separate billing bucket.
- Onboarding kickoff: propose Thu, 21 Oct at 10:00 PT for a 30 min technical kickoff (we'll invite Infra, Security, and the onboarding PM).
- PO timing: to lock current pricing, we need a PO or signed DocuSign by EOD 2027-10-20. If you need more time, we can extend pricing for 7 days with a conditional reserve (small non-refundable booking fee).

DocuSign: we've prepared the SOW envelope and shared a draft link — https://www.docusign.net/envelope/1234-abcdef (works with procurement).

I attached a short runbook draft to show the proposed cutover steps and isolation controls so procurement can review. If the EU enclave requires a full HSM (hardware-backed) flow we'll mark that as an extra security task and schedule an accelerated connector window.

Attachment: redwood_runbook_draft.md (md)

Please reply with: (1) Azure Key Vault confirmation, (2) PO target date, (3) whether you accept the 24-month / 10% prepay structure or want an alternate schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly for you.

—
Neha Kapoor
Lead Technical Program Manager, Renewals | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (212) 555-0123
